sections.title: Minor Requirements
sections.note: No fewer than 5 History of Art (ARTH) courses This includes five courses at the 2000- and 3000-levels one of which must be at the 2000-level two of which must be at the 3000-level or above No more than two courses from the minor may be double-counted toward a student's major or be from a study abroad program. Courses not coded or crosslisted with ARTH or VISST must be approved by the Director of Undergraduate Studies. ARTH 1100 Art Histories: An Introduction is the only course below the 2000-level that may count towards the minor.
